_stage_b_rule: B1 combined recipe: lr = the grid value (3e-4 rung6_base_heldout, 1e-3 rung6_lr1e3, 3e-3 tune_rung6_lr3e-3) with the lowest score (the base lr unless another qualifies); plus every optimizer knob that qualified (warmup15: warmup_frac 0.15, warmup_max 2000; clip3: grad_clip 3.0; wd0.1: weight_decay 0.1); plus the single shape knob with the lowest score, if it qualified (decoder_norm true; n_latents 32; n_latents 512; n_self_layers 6 with mlp_ratio 1; unpatch_hidden 128). Skip B1 if it equals a run already done. Score = mean of the last two heldout_loss values; qualifies = below the reference by more than delta_r = max(0.005, half the range of the score over rung6_base_heldout seeds 0, 1, 2). Delete this key before submission.
